subject.name: Economics
subject.programme: IB DP Economics SL/HL (first exam 2022) – 4 units, 31 subtopics
subject.examPattern: IB DP – graded 1–7; recommended 150 h SL / 240 h HL; exams May (Hindi May only). HL: Paper 1 Extended response 1 h 15, 25 marks (20%) – 1 of 3 two-part questions; Paper 2 Data response 1 h 45, 40 marks (30%) – 1 of 2; Paper 3 Policy paper 1 h 45, 60 marks (30%) – 2 compulsory; IA portfolio of 3 commentaries (20%). SL: P1 30%, P2 40%, IA 30%.
